saints.name: Sts. Simon and Jude
saints.title: Apostles
saints.shortBlurb: Two of the Twelve honored together — Simon the Zealot and Jude Thaddaeus, invoked in desperate causes…
biography: Simon, called the Zealot, and Jude, called Thaddaeus, are named among the Twelve Apostles. Jude is the author of the short Epistle that bears his name and, by long popular devotion, the patron of hopeless and desperate causes. Of their preaching little is recorded with certainty; ancient tradition joins them in mission to Persia, where they were martyred together.
They share this feast in the Roman calendar.
saints.knownFor: Apostolic preaching; Jude, patron of desperate causes.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 28 October
